registry_title: QCR-OS Master Contract Inviolable Invariants & Constitutional Doctrines Registry

master_contract_invariants.requirement: Only explicitly registered sources qualified under Master Contract Article 1 may be queried or ingested into the research platform.
No evidence entity may be created or asserted without direct linkage to a registered source record.
master_contract_invariants.contract_reference: QCR-OS MASTER CONTRACT v2.0 (Article 1, Operating Doctrine)

master_contract_invariants.requirement: Large language models operate purely downstream of deterministic retrieval; model memory may never act as a primary factual source.
master_contract_invariants.contract_reference: QCR-OS MASTER CONTRACT v2.0 (Article 1, Operating Doctrine)

master_contract_invariants.requirement: Evidence extracted from sources must remain ontologically distinct and unmixed with higher-order interpretive analysis or claims.
The canonical Quran text (114 Surahs, 6236 numbered Ayahs, 112 opening Basmalas) is immutable and cryptographically protected.
Every ingested record, claim, or returned token must have complete and resolvable provenance back to primary raw source byte offset.
All knowledge output delivered to UI/researcher must adhere to the single display contract without silent ungrounded text injection.
Once registered and signed, a source version cannot be modified in place; changes require a newly qualified version record.
When an epistemic tier lacks coverage for a topic, the system must not substitute content from another tier to mask the absence.
System errors, retrieval misses, and data integrity anomalies must fail explicitly with structured codes, never silent fallback or hallucinated filler.
Source authority must be evaluated and recorded at the specific field level (e.g. text vs revelation order vs page mapping), not broadly assumed.
Any reconciliation or normalization of source discrepancies in canonical derivation must be backed by explicit human authorization.
No agent, script, tool, or phase may advance itself or transition the system to the next phase without explicit human gate sign-off.
Implementation of features, schemas, or infrastructure belonging to future phases is strictly prohibited in current phase.
If a qualified source is missing or unavailable, it must remain explicitly registered as missing; synthetic substitution is forbidden.
master_contract_invariants.contract_reference: QCR-OS MASTER CONTRACT v2.0 (Article 1, Operating Doctrine)

governing_doctrines.name: SOURCE_BEFORE_EVIDENCE
governing_doctrines.statement: Source qualification, registration, and immutability must precede evidence extraction.

governing_doctrines.name: EVIDENCE_BEFORE_CLAIM
governing_doctrines.statement: Every assertion, fact, or claim must be backed by typed evidence extracted from qualified sources.

governing_doctrines.name: CLAIM_BEFORE_ANALYSIS
governing_doctrines.statement: Higher-order synthesis and analysis must operate strictly over verified claims.

governing_doctrines.name: RETRIEVAL_BEFORE_LLM
governing_doctrines.statement: LLM operates purely downstream of deterministic retrieval, never as an ungrounded memory source.

governing_doctrines.name: PROVENANCE_BEFORE_CITATION
governing_doctrines.statement: No citation or reference may be displayed without complete cryptographic and positional provenance.

governing_doctrines.name: VALIDATION_BEFORE_APPROVAL
governing_doctrines.statement: Artifacts must pass automated and independent verification before human approval can be requested.

governing_doctrines.name: APPROVAL_BEFORE_NEXT_PHASE
governing_doctrines.statement: Transition to phase N+1 requires explicit human approval of phase N deliverables.

governing_doctrines.name: HUMAN_AUTHORIZATION_BEFORE_CUTOVER
governing_doctrines.statement: Production cutover requires shadow parity and explicit separate human authorization.

governing_doctrines.name: KNOWING_ROADMAP_DOES_NOT_AUTHORIZE_TRAVELING_IT
governing_doctrines.statement: Knowledge of future phases grants zero execution or implementation authority in current phase.

architecture_requirements.name: MULTI_AGENT_CORE_PRODUCT_REQUIREMENT
architecture_requirements.statement: Multi-Agent architecture is an immutable core product requirement reserved for Phase 8. It is not an optional technology suggestion.
